claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies a Canon DSLR with model marking reading “EOS 800” (partially visible). Photos do not show the lens model/specs (e.g., 18-55mm) or confirm it is the 800D specifically or UK-sourced.
No shutter count/usage screen or EXIF/shutter-count evidence is shown in the witness photos.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Witness photos show the camera/lens generally, but do not include close-up inspection of lens glass for fungus/scratches.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: Witness explicitly notes battery/charger/cables are not shown, and no repair history documentation is shown.

risks.risk: Lens may not be the claimed 18-55mm kit lens (or may be incomplete/incorrect lens), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the lens front and side showing the exact lens model text (e.g., “EF-S 18-55mm …”) plus a shot of the lens mount label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a Canon DSLR body with an unspecified lens (worst-case: lens condition/compatibility unknown).

risks.risk: Camera may have high shutter count or hidden wear not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A screenshot/reading from the camera or a shutter-count app showing shutter count for the specific unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown shutter count (worst-case: higher usage).

risks.risk: Lens glass may have fungus, haze, or scratches not detectable from the provided angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens glass at multiple angles under light (front element and rear element if visible), plus a quick test shot showing contrast/flare issues.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens with potential optical issues (worst-case: reduced image quality).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, cables, caps, strap, memory card) reduce buyer value and usability.
risks.proof: Photos showing all included items laid out: battery, charger, cables, lens caps/hood, strap, and memory card (with capacity/format visible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera without guaranteed accessories (worst-case: battery/charger not included).

risks.risk: Function issues (autofocus problems, shutter faults, sensor dust/scratches, LCD/viewfinder defects) not shown in the photos.
risks.proof: Short video or live test: autofocus on a moving subject, a focus-check shot, LCD clarity check, and a sensor dust check photo (e.g., bright sky at high f-stop).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/unknown working condition (worst-case: needs service).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the lens model/specs text (confirm whether it is EF-S 18-55mm and the exact variant).
Send a screenshot/reading showing the shutter count for this exact camera.
Send close-up photos of the lens glass (front and rear if possible) under strong light to check fungus/haze/scratches.
Show all included accessories laid out: original battery, charger, cables, lens caps/hood, strap, and memory card (with capacity/format).
Provide a quick functional test video: autofocus on a moving subject and a sample photo set (including one bright-sky frame to check sensor dust).
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies a Canon DSLR with model marking reading “EOS 800” and shows the camera body and lens attached, so it can be priced at its worst-case for an unverified kit. Seller claims about lens model, shutter count, and accessories are not proven by the photos, so the price should assume missing/unknown items and potential optical/function uncertainty.
